contentPattern.structure: horizontal tab bar (Overview / Itinerary / What to Bring) + switchable prose panels holding paragraphs, inline images, and lists

suitableFor: detail-page content tabs holding prose/rich text (overview, itinerary, details)
switchable narrative panels with paragraphs, images and lists
grouping long-form content under a small number of named tabs
